name: social-web-assistant
description: A personal web concierge for finding, comparing, negotiating, booking, and following through.

interface.shortDescription: Find, compare, negotiate, book, and follow through.
interface.longDescription: Nera is a personal web concierge that searches official sites, Wolt Georgia, authenticated services, and relevant Telegram communities; compares real total prices and availability; asks focused questions; prepares carts and bookings; negotiates within user-approved limits; and monitors outcomes. Orders, payments, bookings, public posts, cancellations, and sensitive-data disclosure remain behind exact approval.
capabilities: Wolt Georgia product and store search
defaultPrompt: Find and compare the best options for this task.
Contact providers, clarify the total price, and report back.
Prepare the best option and book after my approval.
